meta.title: Jacky Dev
meta.description: Learn by building. Frontend development notes.

hero.title_line_2: and these are my frontend notes.
hero.philosophy: Breaking complex frontend problems into code we can maintain.
hero.description: Problems from building with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, along with the trade-offs and fixes I found along the way.

component.title: Give each component a clear job
component.description: When UI, data fetching, and effects start getting tangled, I sort out their responsibilities before deciding where to split the component.

state.title: Know where state belongs
state.description: I separate server data from UI state. TanStack Query handles fetching and caching; Zustand handles UI state that needs to be shared.

automation.title: Automate the repeatable checks
automation.description: Types, lint, and tests run in CI so they can be repeated with every change. That leaves review time for design and trade-offs.

case_studies.description: A few topics from implementation work that I keep writing about.

state.title: State refactoring
state.description: Separating fetching, caching, and UI state in existing projects to make data flow easier to trace.

quality.title: Tests and CI
quality.description: Using Vitest, Playwright, and CI to cover workflows that manual checks tend to miss.

performance.title: Content websites
performance.description: Working through metadata, sitemaps, images, and cache updates while balancing SEO and loading speed.

security.title: Permission boundaries
security.description: Keeping sensitive logic on the server with CSP, Route Handler authorization, and a data access layer.

featured_posts.description: Implementation problems, solutions, and the choices behind them.
featured_posts.empty: New notes are on the way. Check back soon.

tech_stack.description: Mostly React, Next.js, and TypeScript. The rest depends on the problem.

about.description: Working through frontend architecture, testing, or a content website? Feel free to get in touch.
